notes.title: Hotfixes
notes.content:
Fixes
Cleaned up the frames for the "apply the formula" exercises

Polished the arrow pointing players to the next dialogue in the diagnostic explanation

Translation of "Bilan"

Adjusted hover animation on the "Quit" button

Adjusted the text box size for exercise statements in the "Training" section

Fixed errors caused by going back and forth between the menu and chapters

Fixed display bug when a correction had only one page

Fixed slot shrinking when picking up an item

Fixed color highlight bug on slots in the "Training" section

Fixed disappearing items thrown into the trash when replaying the exercise

Fixed ignored item on the conveyor belt

Fixed pink display of the "Validate" button after completing the final evaluation

Fixed transparent dotted lines issue

notes.title: Update Notes – September 8, 2025
notes.content:
New Remote Control

The remote now has 5 new buttons!
[table equalcells="1" colwidth="185,365,"][tr][td colwidth="185"]

[/td][td colwidth="365"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266139/abf3edfbc01654c22d33f54115fb761a0b6a3a68.png"]
[/td][td]

[/td][/tr][/table]
You can now:

Move forward or backward in the explanation with the top buttons

Enable/disable automatic playback of corrections with "Play/Pause"

Jump to the next exercise correction or go back to the previous explanation with the yellow buttons


[hr][/hr]Auto-Read Indicator

[table equalcells="1" colwidth="136,408,"][tr][td colwidth="136"]

[/td][td colwidth="408"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266139/100e54ed40b3fb7a9077ca115e823108f860e080.png"]
[/td][td]

[/td][/tr][/table]
White background: "click to continue" mode 

Pauses at the end of each sentence

Grey background: auto-read mode activated

Pauses at each interaction (exercises or dialogue choices)



I’ve heard your feedback that in auto mode, explanations move too quickly. I’m working on the best way to improve this.


[hr][/hr]Fresh Look for the Final Report!


A brand-new notebook design for the final report, better suited to its format.

There’s now an attempt counter!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266139/a346e1127093d9c4d892c7f57743223c2f798463.png"]

And who knows, maybe one day there’ll be a full history ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) 


[hr][/hr]Other Updates and Fixes
Animation for the arrow above the trash bin

Fixed a small display bug in one of the exercise corrections

In the final test, hearts disappeared after the report was shown

notes.title: Update Notes – August 25, 2025
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]Exercise design completely reworked![hr][/hr]A Zoom for better focus


Every practice activity now comes with a zoom straight into the exercise!

[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45266139/3ec4d882d97f8c56a97543a6a40f548ef47d697d.gif"]



It’s not yet applied to all course interactions, but it’s on the way! ;)


[hr][/hr]The Validation Gauge


In my quest to make the game even more fun, I’ve added a little filling gauge to validate your answers.


[table equalcells="1" colwidth="185,320,175"][tr][td colwidth="185"]

[/td][td colwidth="320"]


[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45266139/e0c8ee42dca4a21fd0ffb43d578bb8b72a8839c2.gif"]


[/td][td colwidth="175"]

[/td][/tr][/table]


A bit stressful? ... all the better :D


[hr][/hr]The Tile Dispenser

[table equalcells="1" colwidth="234,237,214"][tr][td colwidth="234"]

[/td][td colwidth="237"]


[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45266139/7d2c6da0abe2f81a6912a747a2d383bf77d33826.gif"]


[/td][td colwidth="214"]

[/td][/tr][/table]


The original idea was that the student would suggest more or less relevant tiles for you to place during the exercises. In the end, I went for a fixed dispenser that provides you with tiles.

It’s less fun, but much easier to set up! x)


[hr][/hr]Button Redesign


No more ugly “Validate,” “Refresh,” “Skip,” and “Back to Menu” buttons randomly scattered across the screen!

They now have their own fixed spot and look much nicer!


[table equalcells="1" colwidth="252,181,252"][tr][td colwidth="252"]

[/td][td colwidth="181"]


[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45266139/49fcc3e29677672a5f1e9c0104bfcc2a40cda3e2.gif"]


[/td][td colwidth="252"]

[/td][/tr][/table]
(I took inspiration from the tabs in the contact form)



[hr][/hr]The Advice Box


Since the characters are no longer visible once you zoom in, I had to find a way to show the teacher’s reactions to what you’re doing…

Say “hello” to the Advice Box!


[table equalcells="1" colwidth="122,421,143"][tr][td colwidth="122"]

[/td][td colwidth="421"]


[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45266139/f84e923256dae5a3a52980b830989edbd28df6e3.gif"]


[/td][td colwidth="143"]

[/td][/tr][/table]


Not only does it react when you’re wrong by guiding you on what to do, but it also holds: tips! (which you can access at any time during the exercise)




[hr][/hr]The Backpack, the Pencil Case, and the Tools


Goodbye to the placement zones scattered around the screen.

Here’s your backpack:
[table equalcells="1" colwidth="27,107,29"][tr][td colwidth="27"]

[/td][td colwidth="107"]


[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45266139/57b84a88397cb140eded9929cd74772107ab9e7d.png"]


[/td][td colwidth="29"]

[/td][/tr][/table]
It lets you store tiles while you figure out where to place them.



And here’s your pencil case:
[table equalcells="1" colwidth="25,189,25"][tr][td colwidth="25"]

[/td][td colwidth="189"]


[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45266139/e8e0880a1fdc7717c0720415099dd700a18ff367.png"]


[/td][td colwidth="25"]

[/td][/tr][/table]


It pops up when you need tools: drawing a line or a circle, writing something, etc. (basically, anything that isn’t a standard tile). I also took the chance to improve the design of some of them.



And I’ve got plenty more ideas to make the tools even better! Stay tuned ;)




[hr][/hr]Trash Life

[table equalcells="1" colwidth="224,243,218"][tr][td colwidth="224"]

[/td][td colwidth="243"]


[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45266139/223aebf48cd6618f9cd55825a6bb839b2330d0f3.gif"]


[/td][td colwidth="218"]

[/td][/tr][/table]
Enjoy the satisfaction of crumpling up a useless tile and tossing it into the trash!
So satisfying that you might end up throwing away useful ones too 😅 Stay sharp!

 
[hr][/hr]Training Section Graphic Upgrade


[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45266139/93a86abd226eeea1de9cbfd7a726a6cec699035d.gif"]

Corrections are now shown in “projector mode,” and you can move between them with the remote

Added speech bubbles when characters talk

The summary now appears in a notebook

Animated hearts in the final evaluation

Questions and diagnostic titles now appear in a header

+ pretty much everything mentioned before



[hr][/hr]Fixes
Overhaul of XML files

Characters disappeared at the end of Chapter 2 when the player hadn’t understood

Question titles were not displayed in the summaries

Tutorials now appear (they were present in the demo but not in the full game until now)

notes.title: Update Notes – June 26, 2025
notes.content:
Take a break!
You can now take a proper, musical and timed break.
Choose a timer: 5, 10, or 15 minutes and enjoy!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266139/ab73cc343336b57669b2c8e29198a2492dae4c99.gif"]Accessible directly from the menu.
Don’t wait for the suggestion! Just click the alarm clock in the menu.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][th]

[/th][th]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266139/129d793cbc534b521d8f3f029cc5b0c36d724287.gif"]
[/th][th]

[/th][/tr][/table]


[hr][/hr]

Super Bobby has arrived (finally)!
Teased for a long time, the version of the intro shown in the game trailer is now playable!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266139/0a9bc9b8f3079457a9c06e2ccb3a15d9f9ebe767.gif"]
[hr][/hr]

Aziz, lights!
Turn the lights off and on again in the menu by clicking the switch or the light bulb.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266139/a85831b5d42f29a2fbb2dd52ad8adeec5f7fcecb.gif"]
[hr][/hr]New Diagnostic
An "Expert" diagnostic appears when the player scores well on previous ones.
Succeeding in these allows you to pre-validate a large part of the 70+ exercises, giving faster access to the final challenge and ending scene.

 (Have you already seen the ending?) 


[hr][/hr]Other Additions
New chapters are now marked with "new"

Throwing the calculator in Chapter 1 now has consequences in the menu

A cat tree has been added to the menu, with interactions!

The teacher speaks in the menu! For Chapter 1 launch only (more coming soon)

Credits updated

The game now runs even when out of focus

“Click to continue” now appears in Chapter 1 speech bubbles after a delay

A tutorial is displayed the first time the drag & drop gameplay appears

ABCD labels added to first MCQs in Chapter 2

Vertical lines added to help explain negative angles

Julie and Robert added to explain Min and Max values

The eraser (available in the demo) is now usable in some full-game challenges
[hr][/hr]

Fixes
A bug introduced in the last update could freeze progression tracking

Game could freeze if a sound to be played was undefined

Dialogue updates

notes.title: Update Notes - June 14, 2025
notes.content:
Menu Overhaul!
The menu had a little issue — it didn’t really highlight the second part of the game: the training section.

With the help of freelance artist Fifii Art, we’ve redesigned the layout and the buttons to give both parts of the game equal importance:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266139/3bb554a9e103ccd50bea830d5bdac5ba917d38f6.gif"]


Everything’s juicier!

I also took the opportunity to polish the hover and click animations for the buttons, which should feel much more satisfying to interact with:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266139/73dc581e13e62e59ff229a8ac85c307d02021cd2.gif"]



[hr][/hr]

Interact with the lightbulb!
After the cat… the light:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266139/47339e9d8db5a8dbcd5f81af16df0dcffab9a4d9.gif"]

You can now interact with the bulb to turn it on and off!

I know what you're thinking:
"But that’s lame... it doesn’t actually light up or darken the room?!"

Hm… let me cook…


[hr][/hr]

Bug Fixes
Some display glitches fixed

A few translation corrections

New builds no longer reset your Chapter 4 progress

notes.title: Update Notes – May 20, 2025
notes.content:
German Translation  

The German version is finally here!  
To all German-speaking players: I hope you enjoy the game!

Translating intentions, jokes, or explanations is not always easy.  
If you spot any awkward phrasing or small mistakes, feel free to send feedback using the "Contact" button in the menu!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266139/672bbe76fe6627a57e76d7535f06c622e0711c07.gif

I truly want the game to be accessible to as many people as possible.  
If your native language isn’t available yet, please be a little patient. :)

[hr][/hr]  
Interact with the Cat!  

Pixel, the cat from the logo, is now interactive!  
Go ahead and give them a little pat! :3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266139/bbca61f7724c504f35d3fd7614c91487593352ee.gif

[hr][/hr]  
Bug Fixes  


The credits page no longer displayed from the main menu
Fixed a few display issues in the English version
The exercise summary in Chapter 4 wouldn’t load in offline mode
Due to a change in XML file reading method, Chapter 4 progress was no longer being saved
"Next" buttons in the corrections were repositioned for consistency
Added a double-click protection on logo elements
